column2: Ultimate 34-Litre Rolo Multi-Purpose Wheelie School Bag Grey + Orange
column4:
The Rolo school bag isn’t just a backpack on wheels; it’s a futuristic marvel straight out of a sci-fi movie. Designed with cutting-edge technology and extensive research, our bag sets a new standard for performance and durability. Our mission? To create the ultimate school trolley bag, far surpassing industry norms. School bags have been made the same forever this is the first school bags that has come to disrupt the industry.

Unique Packing System – More space

One of the standout features of the Rolo school bag is its innovative packing system. By integrating the large wheels into the exterior design, we’ve eliminated the need for wheel wells that consume valuable interior space. This clever design allows for maximum storage capacity, enabling you to organize your books neatly from side to side like a well-arranged bookshelf. The inclusion of two dividers ensures your items are easy to identify and retrieve, promoting effortless organization.

Ease of Mobility

Our big wheels are engineered to keep the center of gravity close to the rotation axis, making the bag feel remarkably light when in motion. They glide effortlessly over uneven surfaces, and thanks to their silent operation, they won’t damage floors. To enhance maneuverability, the pull-up trolley handle locks firmly into place once extended, ensuring stability and ease during movement. Going up and down steps just got easier. The Rolo School Bag is designed to be quiet and gentle on your floors, ensuring no noise or damage.

Superior Protection

Constructed from high-quality polypropylene plastic, the Rolo school trolley bag offers unmatched protection for your books and supplies. Unlike traditional nylon, which can leave your items vulnerable to the elements, our robust material acts as an exoskeleton armor, ensuring your belongings stay safe and secure.

Thoughtful Storage Solutions

Designed with practicality in mind, the Rolo bag features a dedicated storage compartment for your lunch, drinks, full-sized pencil case, cellphone, and charger. This compartment is easily accessed with an easy to reach clip, keeping your valuables out of sight yet within reach. For added peace of mind, the Rolo also includes additional padlock locking facilties.

Easy Fix

Having a broken school bag that has to go in for repairs can be a traumatic experience. With the Rolo school trolley bag most of the parts can be replaced with a simple screw , reducing down time and increasing longevity.

column2: 1 oz Silver Krugerrand tube of 25 (Mixed Years)
column4:
The 1 oz Krugerrand Silver Coin is crafted from 99.9% fine silver, weighing 31.10 g with a diameter of 38.70 mm. Recognised worldwide, the Krugerrand stands as both an investment piece and a cultural icon, rooted in South Africa’s rich history. The front of the coin showcases the graceful springbok antelope, one of South Africa’s national emblems, depicted mid-leap across the savannah. This timeless design by renowned sculptor Coert Steynberg reflects both the country’s natural beauty and its artistic heritage. The inscriptions include “Fynsilwer” (Afrikaans for “fine silver”) and “R1”, indicating its face value of one Rand. The reverse features a detailed portrait of President Paul Kruger, a figure central to South Africa’s history. Designed by Otto Schultz, the portrait is framed by the bilingual inscriptions “Suid-Afrika” and “South Africa”, emphasizing the coin’s national significance directly from Rand Refinery.

column2: Luggage Glove  Diamond S’CURE (Low Ride) Collection Large Red
column4:
A South African invention and the world’s only original locking luggage cover, it will cover your upright spinner or trolley and lock shut. No more plasticwrapping!

NB: this is the ‘LOW RIDE’ version of the Luggage Glove Diamond. Some suitcase models have designs close to the ground so on the original version, the lock scrapes on the ground. This model addresses those issues by moving the lock to the back the case for ground clearance. Choose this model if your rolling suitcase has less than 5cm ground clearance! This model is only available with a RED trim. Please consult our luggage sizer below and make sure you verify that your luggage has less than 5cm ride-height.

The Luggage Glove fits over your luggage with a sturdy, elastic 3-D Mesh material. An adjustable bottom strap with a constrictor mechanism connects a high quality 3 dial TSA combination lock to close shut. Your suitcase is now instantly recognisable, protected from the mishaps of travel, safer from pilferage and as a re-useable item, environmentally conscious instead of single-use plastic normally used at airports.

We’ve made a basic list of suitcases and brands in the market where this version is ideally suited for:

Every traveler interested in protecting and securing your luggage should have one – especially if you are concerned about single-use plastic polluting our airports.

Lock. Protect. Recognise.

column2: New Luggage Glove Diamond 2.0 DUO Collection Small Black
column4:
The Luggage Glove Diamond has established itself as THE preferred luggage protection device. The highly-anticipated DUO upgrade now offers subtle fitting and aesthetic improvements as well as an incredibly distinctive colour pattern allowing instant recognition of your luggage but also differentiating itself from the many copy-cat products on the market. DUO continues where Diamond left off: luggage protection, security, easy identification and preventing the need of despicable single-use plastic to cover your luggage.

The Luggage Glove DUO fits over your luggage with a sturdy, elastic 3-D Mesh material and secures shut with a TSA-recognised combination lock that you can set to your preference. Luggage Glove have improved the lock and position by moving it to the back of the suitcase catering now for suitcases with ‘lower ride heights’ and trolleys.

Besides this feature, other improvements include:

  • a subtle reverse of protective material on the side panels to create a distinctive look
  • incredible colour combinations with premium looks
  • modified and optimised side carry handles
  • invisible seams, one again to give a more premium look for your money spent
  • Improved sizing for popular and common luggage products in the market
  • Improved bottom skirt to use wheels to full functionality and reduce weight further

With regards to fitting, the DUO is specifically designed for spinner and trolley luggage. As a rule of thumb:
– Cabin will fit 55cm suitcases
– Small will fit smaller check-in cases ranging from 65cm to 64cm in suitcase height
– Medium, the most common, will fit Medium to Large check-in sizes ranging from 65cm to 80cm in height
– Large fits the ‘extra large volume cases’

Should you need assistance with the perfect fit, please send us a question below or contact us for more information. Every traveler interested in protecting and securing your luggage should have one – especially if you are concerned about single-use plastic polluting our airports.

column2: Gino De Vinci Brezza Spinner Collection 3 piece Black
column4:
EXCLUDES BEAUTY CASE

You’ll always sacrifice weight when it comes to a framed hard suitcase but the Gino De Vinci Brezza does well giving you the best of security with out too much gain in weight. An affordable multi-lock suitcase that ticks many boxes from a security perspective. Good looks and a solid construction that has prove itself over many, many trips.

The polypropylene material is tough and significantly robust when designed with the 3 lock systems provided. The main lock is TSA-approved whilst the other two latch locks give another element of comfort whilst in transit.

The lined front paneling is well designed and with the red trim colours across both blue and grey colour options, works well as a package. Sage Green and Champagne are two new colour options for the 2025 season.

All the fundamentals are there including a lined interior with divider and retainer ribbons.

As far as hard, framed suitcases go, we feel the GDV Brezza is at a great price point if you prefer not to travel with zipper or soft options. The quality is great whilst it doesn’t carry famous brand names, we’ve had many compliments on design and performance and local back up support is nothing short of excellent.

column2: BG Berlin SODA 55cm Spinner Collection Green
column4:
Besides 4 beautiful colour options, the highly anticipated BG Berlin SODA has hit the shelves with fantastic features. A unique front mould design gives it a lot of character but BG BErlin have also designed these cases with more curvature on the edges giving the new, trendy European look that is in such demand at the moment. As always from this brand, superb construction along with the best YKK zippers and an expansion zipper make this incredible value-for-money for the case you are getting. Backed by a European quality and warranty system, you won’t go wrong.

As with most suitcases, you can buy a mould and put your name on it. The difference between the better brands (such as BG Berlin) is that they won’t cut corners with the quality of the fittings and the manufacturing processes. This beautiful ridged design is exclusive to the South African market and BG BErlin have pulled out the design stops by including rugged YKK size 10 zips, an expansion system, printed handles, badges and unique identifiers, finished with 4 tough and mobile double spinner wheels.

The inner lining of the case features the familiar divider with zipper along with mesh pockets and a spine pocket for your organisation. Retainer straps are used on the inner to help hold your personal items whilst in transit.

The telescopic handle reaches many levels and will get to the optimum height for you to enjoy mobility in the airport and surrounds.

3 sizes are on offer with a generous 103L in the curved Large suitcase. Using the expansion feature will give you that little bit extra packing space which may be very useful to you on your trips back. Whilst black is a dependable and solid option the other 3 colours offer a summery feel: blue, green and lavender shades.

Keep an eye out for the Soda 3-piece set bargain due to be launched soon but if you are looking for top-notch value-for-money branded luggage below the R3000 price point then you can’t go wrong with the BG Berlin Soda – a refreshing take on luggage design and looks!

- Compact and Lightweightx: Despite its roomy interior, our ride-on trolley suitcase is lightweight and easy to handle. It's designed to fit in overhead compartments and car trunks with ease.
- Security Featuresx: Safety is a priority, and our suitcase includes child-friendly locks to keep their belongings secure while on the move.
- Independent Travelx: Empower your child to take responsibility for their own belongings and enjoy a sense of independence as they wheel their suitcase alongside you during your travels.
- Versatile Usex: While it's perfect for travel, the ride-on trolley suitcase is also suitable for play at home. Your child can use it for imaginative games, creating their adventures.
Our Panda Ride-On Trolley Suitcase is more than just luggage; it's an invitation to adventure and independence. Whether it's the dual functionality, the roomy interior, or the captivating designs, this suitcase ensures that your child's travel experience is entertaining and enjoyable. column4:
Trunk designs are not particularly common now-a-days and spinner versions thereof even less so. Delsey have brought this back into fashion with the stunning Chatelet Air 2.0 version offered in 3 colour options with exquisite finish and materials. A lovely option as part of their travel spinners so sought after.

The innovative format, coupled with four robust and highly maneuverable double wheels, ensures a comfortable roll wherever your adventures take you. The rectangular shape unlocks new possibilities for travel, making it perfect for car or train journeys – the latter especially useful for long walks down narrow passages.

Security is paramount, and the TSA combination lock offers peace of mind. This lock allows you to secure your belongings with a personal code while permitting TSA to inspect without damage. The patented SECURITECH® 2 zip, three times more secure than conventional zips, reinforces the ultra-secure closure system.

Packing becomes a breeze with two compartments featuring adjustable straps, maximizing space and each section has it’s own zipper divider. The Extra Large size holds a 104L of packing space with a 5.38kg weight. Laundry and shoe bags are included to add that little bit of extra convenience when packing and organising you personal stuff.

Delsey brings Parisian flair with world-class quality and materials. We know the price is premium but you do get international representation and a luxurious travel brand that is recognised and indeed, applauded, all around the world.

column2: Secrid Original Twin Wallet Red
column4:
SECRID TWIN WALLET, THE WALLET OF TOMORROW

The Secrid twin wallet is an easy to use credit card wallet made from aluminium and real leather. The core of the wallet are two aluminium cardprotectors. Inside each cardprotector there is space for 6 cards. Just by one click all cards slide out gradually. All cards in one view and easy to take out the right debt card.

A special coating inside prevent the cards from damaging and falling out.

Plastic cards get often squashed into wallets. Become bent when put in back pockets and the chemical interaction with leather makes them brittle. As a result many cards will break within their first year of usage. The aluminium Secrid card protector prevents this.

The latest cards like credit cards, ID cards and admission cards have a RFID or NFC chip inside. It can been copied from a distance up to 30 meters. The Secrid card protector prevents this possibility. This has been tested and confirms by TNO in the Netherlands. Secrid offers the perfect firewall for your wallet.

Besides the 12 cards inside the two cardprotectors, there is space for 4 extra cards inside the leather slots. And also 6 banknotes and two or three coins. So there is no need to have an extra wallet next to your Secrid twin wallet. The Secrid twin wallet is a smart mix between a credit card case and a regular wallet.

The twin wallet from Secrid is so strong that you have a two year warranty on sliding system and leather stitches.

This article is excellent to give to a man and is beautiful packaged in a luxurious black box.

Secrid twin wallet is available in many styles and colors. There are three styles: original, amazon and limited editions. Best selling colors are: vintage brown, original black, vintage black, vintage cognac, vintage blue, amazon brown, amazon black and limited purple-pink.

- Space for 16 cards and 6 banknotes and some coins. Less cards means more banknotes.

It also includes an additional zipper pocket for your shirts to be kept wrinkle free. Finally, to top it off, Samsonite have used their Recyclex eco-friendly material as a commitment to the lowering their manufacturing footprint on the environment.

A superb feature of this luggage is the double–suspension system used in the spinner wheels. This limits vibrations on the go giving the feeling of effortless and uninhibited travel.

The cable also allows the expansion feature to be used and still fastened shut – all with a US TSA-recognised 3-dial combination lock.

Corner and back protectors are customised for the suitcases to add further bump protection and safeguarding your internal telescopic handle. Additional carry system includes side and top grips for carrying and packing into your vehicles.

Internally, the Spectrolite uses the advantage of soft-side luggage with an 2 internal pockets on the main lid, a wetpack and lateral divider which is excellent for clothing seperation or compression. It also includes an additional zipper pocket for your shirts to be kept wrinkle free. Finally, to top it off, Samsonite have used their Recyclex eco-friendly material as a commitment to the lowering their manufacturing footprint on the environment.

Available in two distinguished colour options with a host of features and the world-supported Samsonite brand, the Sepctrolite 3.0 is sure to set the standard for soft-side business luggage.

What makes Samsonite’s Lite-Shock special is the lightweight and durability found in its hard shell. Samsonite has formulated this technology by weaving fibers of durable polypropylene together, transforming them into individual sheets which are quickly reinforced and fused together to form an ultra-strong outer shell.

This suitcase is a 4-wheeler which makes it easy to move around when travelling. It has an extractable trolley handle that has a push-button that adjusts to different heights. There are also two rubber handles on the top and side that make it easy for you to carry. You pack inside each half of the suitcase. To organize your packing, there are internal compression straps that tighten down your clothes. There is also a material divider inside that allows you to separate your packing so you can pack more organized.

From a security point of view, Lite-Shock has a built-in TSA combination lock that safely locks your zips. You will need a TSA lock for all travel to and within the United States. The zips are also inversed and this conceals the zip track from the outside of the suitcase to prevent anyone from trying to open it. There is a luggage label slot at the back for you to fill in your personal details. Each suitcase in this range comes with a 10 year global warranty

The Luggage Glove Diamond has become the ‘must-have’ accessory for your travels. A South African invention and the world’s only original locking luggage cover, it will cover your upright spinner or trolley and lock shut. No more plasticwrapping!

The Luggage Glove fits over your luggage with a sturdy, elastic 3-D Mesh material. An adjustable bottom strap with a constrictor mechanism connects a high quality Taiwanese 3 dial TSA combination lock to close shut. Your suitcase is now instantly recognisable, protected from the mishaps of travel, safer from pilferage and as a re-useable item, environmentally conscious instead of single-use plastic normally used at airports.

Luggage is generally produced in proportion so the Luggage Glove has 4 sizes (1 carry-on version and sizes S,M and L for check-in) to fit almost any piece of upright wheeled luggage. An adjustable bottom strap tightens around your case to ensure a tight squeeze and there are additional optional security straps that can be used to increase level of security even further.

An accurate sizing chart can be found in the gallery of the product options but as a rule of thumb:
– Cabin will fit 55cm suitcases
– Small will fit smaller check-in cases ranging from 60cm to 67cm in suitcase height
– Medium, the most common, will fit Medium check-in sizes ranging from 65cm to 75cm in height
– Large fits the bigger check-in sizes ranging from 75cm + in height

Every traveler interested in protecting and securing your luggage should have one – especially if you are concerned about single-use plastic polluting our airports.

Lock. Protect. Recognise.

The Luggage Glove Diamond has become the ‘must-have’ accessory for your travels. A South African invention and the world’s only original locking luggage cover, it will cover your upright spinner or trolley and lock shut. No more plasticwrapping!

The Luggage Glove fits over your luggage with a sturdy, elastic 3-D Mesh material. An adjustable bottom strap with a constrictor mechanism connects a high quality Taiwanese 3 dial TSA combination lock to close shut. Your suitcase is now instantly recognisable, protected from the mishaps of travel, safer from pilferage and as a re-useable item, environmentally conscious instead of single-use plastic normally used at airports.

Luggage is generally produced in proportion so the Luggage Glove has 4 sizes (1 carry-on version and sizes S,M and L for check-in) to fit almost any piece of upright wheeled luggage. An adjustable bottom strap tightens around your case to ensure a tight squeeze and there are additional optional security straps that can be used to increase level of security even further.

An accurate sizing chart can be found in the gallery of the product options but as a rule of thumb:
– Cabin will fit 55cm suitcases
– Small will fit smaller check-in cases ranging from 60cm to 67cm in suitcase height
– Medium, the most common, will fit Medium check-in sizes ranging from 65cm to 75cm in height
– Large fits the bigger check-in sizes ranging from 75cm + in height

Every traveler interested in protecting and securing your luggage should have one – especially if you are concerned about single-use plastic polluting our airports.

The Luggage Glove Diamond has become the ‘must-have’ accessory for your travels. A South African invention and the world’s only original locking luggage cover, it will cover your upright spinner or trolley and lock shut. No more plasticwrapping!

The Luggage Glove fits over your luggage with a sturdy, elastic 3-D Mesh material. An adjustable bottom strap with a constrictor mechanism connects a high quality Taiwanese 3 dial TSA combination lock to close shut. Your suitcase is now instantly recognisable, protected from the mishaps of travel, safer from pilferage and as a re-useable item, environmentally conscious instead of single-use plastic normally used at airports.

Luggage is generally produced in proportion so the Luggage Glove has 4 sizes (1 carry-on version and sizes S,M and L for check-in) to fit almost any piece of upright wheeled luggage. An adjustable bottom strap tightens around your case to ensure a tight squeeze and there are additional optional security straps that can be used to increase level of security even further.

An accurate sizing chart can be found in the gallery of the product options but as a rule of thumb:
– Cabin will fit 55cm suitcases
– Small will fit smaller check-in cases ranging from 60cm to 67cm in suitcase height
– Medium, the most common, will fit Medium check-in sizes ranging from 65cm to 75cm in height
– Large fits the bigger check-in sizes ranging from 75cm + in height

Every traveler interested in protecting and securing your luggage should have one – especially if you are concerned about single-use plastic polluting our airports.

column2: Mark Ryden Compact Pro Laptop Backpack

Laptop Backpack

This Mark Ryden 17 inch Laptop backpack is one of the best selling styles in the whole range. When you see all the features, you will understand why.

There are 3 zips on the front of the backpack. the very top zip is for a small pocket which is 10cm high x 23cm wide. The Vertical Zip on the front is a little deeper and is handy for parking tickets or notes needed for quick access. The U - Shaped zip at the top is deep and goes down and wide the whole length of the backpack. There are 4 organised pockets in there as well as a detachable keyring so you can always find your keys.

The Main Zip of the backpack has double zip sliders which can be locked. There are 4 organiser pockets, as well as a large open section where you could pack an overnight section of clothes. The cable from the USB port outside also feeds into this main section. This cable is used to plug into your powerbank. Your cellphone then gets plugged into the USB port outside the backpack to charge your cellphone as you walk The back of this pocket has 2 sections. 1 is for a 10 inch tablet. The other is for a Laptop up to 17 inches.

Outside on the back are the double backpack straps. The left backpack strap has a small zip for carrying some cash or coins. This is a very useful security feature to allow you to pay for something small and leave your backpack on your back. These straps are ergonomically designed with comfort in mind. There is also a belt attached to the backpack to allow you to slide the backpack over a cabin trolley handle for ease of carry within airports and while travelling. There is a security zip on the back of the backpack to store your valuables like Money and Passport.

The Luggage Glove Diamond has become the ‘must-have’ accessory for your travels. A South African invention and the world’s only original locking luggage cover, it will cover your upright spinner or trolley and lock shut. No more plasticwrapping!

The Luggage Glove fits over your luggage with a sturdy, elastic 3-D Mesh material. An adjustable bottom strap with a constrictor mechanism connects a high quality Taiwanese 3 dial TSA combination lock to close shut. Your suitcase is now instantly recognisable, protected from the mishaps of travel, safer from pilferage and as a re-useable item, environmentally conscious instead of single-use plastic normally used at airports.

An adjustable bottom strap tightens around your case to ensure a tight squeeze and there are additional optional security straps that can be used to increase level of security even further.

– Cabin will fit 55cm suitcases
– Small will fit smaller check-in cases ranging from 60cm to 67cm in suitcase height
– Medium, the most common, will fit Medium check-in sizes ranging from 65cm to 75cm in height
– Large fits the bigger check-in sizes ranging from 75cm + in height

The Luggage Glove Diamond has become the ‘must-have’ accessory for your travels. A South African invention and the world’s only original locking luggage cover, it will cover your upright spinner or trolley and lock shut. No more plasticwrapping!

The Luggage Glove fits over your luggage with a sturdy, elastic 3-D Mesh material. An adjustable bottom strap with a constrictor mechanism connects a high quality Taiwanese 3 dial TSA combination lock to close shut. Your suitcase is now instantly recognisable, protected from the mishaps of travel, safer from pilferage and as a re-useable item, environmentally conscious instead of single-use plastic normally used at airports.

Luggage is generally produced in proportion so the Luggage Glove has 4 sizes (1 carry-on version and sizes S,M and L for check-in) to fit almost any piece of upright wheeled luggage. An adjustable bottom strap tightens around your case to ensure a tight squeeze and there are additional optional security straps that can be used to increase level of security even further.

An accurate sizing chart can be found in the gallery of the product options but as a rule of thumb:
– Cabin will fit 55cm suitcases
– Small will fit smaller check-in cases ranging from 60cm to 67cm in suitcase height
– Medium, the most common, will fit Medium check-in sizes ranging from 65cm to 75cm in height
– Large fits the bigger check-in sizes ranging from 75cm + in height

Every traveler interested in protecting and securing your luggage should have one – especially if you are concerned about single-use plastic polluting our airports.

Lock. Protect. Recognise.
